question: Where is the nearest hotel while traveling toward Sanders Park, Mount Pleasant, WI from Memory Garden, Mequon, WI?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( -- Try to find "Memory Garden, Mequon, WI" as a POI SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mequon%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 UNION ALL -- If not found as a POI, try to find it as a park within Mequon city SELECT p.geometry FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Mequon%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( -- Find "Sanders Park, Mount Pleasant, WI" as a park within Mount Pleasant city SELECT p.geometry FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Sanders Park%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Mount Pleasant%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.amenity, p.leisure, p.tourism, p.cuisine, p.museum, p.healthcare, p.takeaway, p.drive_through, p.outdoor_seating, p.emergency, p.restaurant FROM pois AS p, (SELECT geometry FROM start_point LIMIT 1) AS sp, end_point AS ep WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND sp.geometry IS NOT NULL -- Ensure the start point was found AND ep.geometry IS NOT NULL -- Ensure the end point was found -- Filter for hotels that are closer to the destination than the origin, -- which interprets "traveling toward" as being "on the way" AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) ORDER BY -- Order by proximity to the destination to find the nearest among the "on the way" hotels p.geometry::geography <-> ep.geometry::geography LIMIT 1;
